verdict.rationale: The models page documents versioned IDs such as jev-1.13.0 and the aliases jev-latest and jev-preview that resolve to them. It states the alias policy (jev-latest is the most recent stable release and the SDK default) and explicitly advises pinning the versioned ID. The response's model field reports which versioned ID answered, and the selection mechanism via the request's model field is documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that pinning and alias resolution behave as documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pin an exact versioned model ID while aliases track the latest release, with the alias-to-version policy documented

citations.quote: If you have tuned confidence thresholds against a specific version, pin that version's ID instead of the alias and move to the new one on your own schedule.
The most recent stable, official release. The default in our client SDKs
The request's `model` field selects which one handles the call
